; 玄渊装备洗练1.1：TXT导入后的随机词条核心。
; 普通15类等权；攻速突破每词条独立千分之一并替换该词条位。
[@XY_WASH_PICK_27]
{
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 0
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 0
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_NATIVE -1
#IF
RANDOMEX 1 1000
#ACT
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 40
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 1
BREAK

GOTO @XY_WASH_PICK_NORMAL_27
}

[@XY_WASH_PICK_NORMAL_27]
{
#IF
RANDOMEX 1 15
#ACT
FORMULATION <$BOXITEM[27].HDC>/2 N$XY_WASH_PICK_MAX
#IF
SMALL <$BOXITEM[27].HDC> 2
#ACT
GOTO @XY_WASH_PICK_NORMAL_27
BREAK
#IF
#ACT
MOVR N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 1 <$STR(N$XY_WASH_PICK_MAX)>
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 43
BREAK

#IF
RANDOMEX 1 14
#ACT
FORMULATION <$BOXITEM[27].HMC>/2 N$XY_WASH_PICK_MAX
#IF
SMALL <$BOXITEM[27].HMC> 2
#ACT
GOTO @XY_WASH_PICK_NORMAL_27
BREAK
#IF
#ACT
MOVR N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 1 <$STR(N$XY_WASH_PICK_MAX)>
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 44
BREAK

#IF
RANDOMEX 1 13
#ACT
FORMULATION <$BOXITEM[27].HSC>/2 N$XY_WASH_PICK_MAX
#IF
SMALL <$BOXITEM[27].HSC> 2
#ACT
GOTO @XY_WASH_PICK_NORMAL_27
BREAK
#IF
#ACT
MOVR N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 1 <$STR(N$XY_WASH_PICK_MAX)>
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 45
BREAK

#IF
RANDOMEX 1 12
#ACT
#IF
RANDOMEX 80 100
#ACT
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 46
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 1
BREAK
#IF
#ACT
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 46
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 2
BREAK

#IF
RANDOMEX 1 11
#ACT
#IF
RANDOMEX 80 100
#ACT

MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 1
BREAK
#IF
#ACT

BREAK

#IF

#IF

MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 51
BREAK
#IF
#ACT
MOVR N$XY_WASH_PICK_VALUE 31 50
MOV N$XY_WASH_PICK_LINE 51
BREAK

#IF
